title: api.error_body
description: HTTP status and exact JSON body of an API error (BE-API-2, BE-API-4, BE-API-8, BE-API-13..18). Bodies are compact JSON with keys in this order: status, error, code, then error_details (or provider). Failure types: not_found {resource} -> 404 code '<resource>_not_found'; method_not_allowed {code} -> 405; validation {messages: {field: [codes]}} -> 422 code validation_errors with error_details = messages; single_validation {code, field?} -> 422 with error_details {field (default 'base'): [code]}; forbidden {code?} -> 403 (default code feature_unavailable); unauthorized {message?} -> 401 {status, error: message} (default message 'unauthorized'); lock_acquisition {code?} -> 422 (default code lock_acquisition_failed); third_party {third_party, code, message} -> 422 code third_party_error; too_many_provider_requests {provider_name, message} -> 429; missing_root {param} -> 400 'BadRequest: param is missing or the value is empty or invalid: <param>'; unauthenticated -> 401 'Unauthorized'; route_not_found -> 404 code resource_not_found; service {code, message} -> unhandled (error server_error, HTTP 500).
